race.description: Ladbrokes Flex Your Multi Stays Alive Mdn Plate
race.comment: BELLA BLAZE (1) sets the standard after consecutive seconds, the latest a Ballarat placing where she was beaten a long neck after travelling just off the lead. She should be ready to peak now and sets up well. SEAGOE (7) is the clear danger after resuming with a second at this track, beaten just under two lengths despite being bumped at the start and eased approaching the 900m. She'll land on speed and give a sight. VICTIMISED (8) has placed at both runs this campaign and the booking of Damian Lane is significant on the quick turnaround from a good draw. JENNI THE FRENCH (3) is the most appealing debut runner for team Maher with a close Cranbourne trial second giving her enough grounding to challenge.
